mapper.select: SELECT FROM trading_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_order_id = #{clientOrderId}
SELECT FROM trading_order WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM trading_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM trading_position WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_order (public_no, user_id, client_order_id, symbol, order_type, side, lots, leverage, limit_price, take_profit, stop_loss, frozen_amount, notional_usd, status) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{userId}, #{clientOrderId}, #{symbol}, #{orderType}, #{side}, #{lots}, #{leverage}, #{limitPrice}, #{takeProfit}, #{stopLoss}, #{frozenAmount}, #{notionalUsd}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_order SET status = 'FILLED', fill_price = #{fillPrice}, position_id = #{positionId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE trading_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_position (public_no, user_id, order_id, symbol, side, lots, leverage, open_price, contract_size, quote_ccy, open_usd_rate, notional_usd, margin, fee, maintenance_margin_rate, liquidation_price, take_profit, stop_loss, status, opened_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{lots}, #{leverage}, #{openPrice}, #{contractSize}, #{quoteCcy}, #{openUsdRate}, #{notionalUsd}, #{margin}, #{fee}, #{maintenanceMarginRate}, #{liquidationPrice}, #{takeProfit}, #{stopLoss}, 'OPEN', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trading_position WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'OPEN' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_position SET status = 'CLOSED', close_price = #{closePrice}, realized_pnl = #{pnl}, close_reason = #{reason}, closed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_position (public_no, user_id, order_id, parent_id, symbol, side, lots, leverage, open_price, contract_size, quote_ccy, open_usd_rate, notional_usd, margin, fee, swap_total, split_swap_seq, maintenance_margin_rate, liquidation_price, take_profit, stop_loss, status, opened_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{parentId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{lots}, #{leverage}, #{openPrice}, #{contractSize}, #{quoteCcy}, #{openUsdRate}, #{notionalUsd}, #{margin}, #{fee}, #{swapTotal}, #{splitSwapSeq}, #{maintenanceMarginRate}, #{liquidationPrice}, #{takeProfit}, #{stopLoss}, 'OPEN', #{openedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM trading_swap WHERE position_id = #{positionId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading_swap WHERE position_id = #{parentId} AND rollover_date = #{date} AND id <= #{seq})
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_position SET take_profit = #{takeProfit}, stop_loss = #{stopLoss} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE trading_position SET margin = #{margin}, liquidation_price = #{liquidationPrice} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('P', p.public_no) AS id, p.symbol, p.side, p.lots, p.open_price, p.close_price, p.realized_pnl AS pnl, p.fee, LOWER(p.close_reason) AS kind, p.closed_at AS at, p.id AS seq, pp.public_no AS parent_no FROM trading_position p LEFT JOIN trading_position pp ON pp.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'CLOSED' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('O', public_no), symbol, side, lots, limit_price, NULL, NULL, 0, 'cancelled', cancelled_at, id, NULL FROM trading_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, side, lots, open_price, close_price, pnl, fee, kind, at, parent_no FROM () h ORDER BY at DESC, seq DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () h
SELECT FROM trading_order WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'PENDING' AND ((side = 'BUY' AND limit_price >= #{ask}) OR (side = 'SELL' AND limit_price <= #{bid})) ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM trading_position WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'OPEN' AND ((side = 'BUY' AND (liquidation_price >= #{bid} OR take_profit <= #{bid} OR stop_loss >= #{bid})) OR (side = 'SELL' AND (liquidation_price <= #{ask} OR take_profit >= #{ask} OR stop_loss <= #{ask}))) ORDER BY id

SELECT FROM trading_position p WHERE p.opened_at < #{at} AND (p.status = 'OPEN' OR p.closed_at > #{at}) AND p.symbol IN #{s} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading_swap s WHERE s.position_id = p.id AND s.rollover_date = #{date})
AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading_swap s2 WHERE s2.position_id = p.parent_id AND s2.rollover_date = #{date} AND s2.id <= p.split_swap_seq)) ORDER BY p.id
SELECT FROM trading_position WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO trading_swap (position_id, user_id, symbol, rollover_date, rollover_at, rate, price, usd_rate, amount) VALUES (#{positionId}, #{userId}, #{symbol}, #{date}, #{at}, #{rate}, #{price}, #{usdRate}, #{amount})
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_position SET margin = #{margin}, liquidation_price = #{liquidationPrice}, swap_total = swap_total + #{amount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN lots END), 0) AS long_lots, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'SELL' THEN lots END), 0) AS short_lots, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'BUY' THEN notional_usd END), 0) AS long_notional, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'SELL' THEN notional_usd END), 0) AS short_notional FROM trading_position WHERE status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY symbol
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM trading_position WHERE status = 'OPEN'
SELECT below, notified, last_notified_at FROM trading_margin_call WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_margin_call (user_id, below, notified, last_notified_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{below}, #{notified}, #{lastNotifiedAt}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE below = VALUES(below), notified = VALUES(notified), last_notified_at = VALUES(last_notified_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_margin_call m SET below = 0, notified = 0, updated_at = #{now} WHERE m.below = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading_position p WHERE p.user_id = m.user_id AND p.status = 'OPEN')
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, balance AS amount FROM trading_account WHERE user_id IN #{i}
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM trading_position WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND user_id IN #{i} GROUP BY user_id
